detail: Service account has 1 user-managed JSON key(s) (long-lived credentials).
remediation: Delete user-managed keys and use workload identity / impersonation.

check_title: Primitive role assigned to a human user
detail: Primitive role roles/owner assigned to a human user.
remediation: Replace primitive roles with least-privilege custom roles and groups.

check_title: Project IAM binding grants anonymous/all-authenticated access
detail: No bindings for allUsers / allAuthenticatedUsers.
remediation: Remove public bindings; use signed URLs / IAP where sharing is required.

detail: Bucket is publicly readable (allUsers in IAM policy or legacy ACL).
remediation: Remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers bindings and enable public access prevention.

detail: Uniform bucket-level access is disabled (legacy object ACLs in use).
remediation: Enable uniform bucket-level access on all buckets.

detail: Object versioning is disabled.
remediation: Enable versioning on buckets holding mutable data.

check_title: Bucket not using customer-managed encryption key
detail: Bucket uses Google-managed encryption keys, not a CMEK.
remediation: Configure default KMS keys on buckets where required.

check_title: Bucket not using customer-managed encryption key
detail: Bucket uses Google-managed encryption keys, not a CMEK.
remediation: Configure default KMS keys on buckets where required.

check_title: Firewall rule exposes management ports to the internet
detail: Firewall rule exposes ports [443] to 0.0.0.0/0.
remediation: Restrict source ranges; use IAP tunnel for SSH and remove broad rules.

check_title: Firewall rule exposes management ports to the internet
detail: Firewall rule exposes ports [22] to 0.0.0.0/0.
remediation: Restrict source ranges; use IAP tunnel for SSH and remove broad rules.

check_title: Default VPC contains open firewall rules
detail: Default VPC contains open firewall rules: allow-ssh-legacy.
remediation: Disable the default network; create hardened VPCs with deny-by-default rules.

check_title: Disk not using customer-managed encryption key
detail: Disk uses Google-managed key, not CMEK.
remediation: Use CMEK for disks where compliance requires key control.

detail: Shielded VM (secure boot / vTPM / integrity monitoring) is disabled.
remediation: Enable secure boot, vTPM and integrity monitoring on instances.

check_title: Cloud SQL instance only has public IP
detail: Cloud SQL instance only has a public IP address.
remediation: Assign a private IP and disable public IP on Cloud SQL instances.

check_title: Cloud SQL does not require SSL
detail: Cloud SQL does not require SSL/TLS connections.
remediation: Set require_ssl=true (and enforce TLS 1.2+).

detail: Automated backups are disabled.
remediation: Enable automated backups with a suitable retention window.

detail: KMS key rotation is not configured (or period > 90 days).
remediation: Configure rotation period <= 90 days for symmetric keys.

detail: Admin activity audit logging is not enabled for the project.
remediation: Enable admin activity (and optionally data access) audit logs for all services.

check_title: No log sinks for external log export
detail: No log sinks export logs to an external SIEM/storage for retention and correlation.
remediation: Create log sinks to BigQuery/PubSub/Storage with a retention policy.

detail: GKE cluster nodes have public IPs (not a private cluster).
remediation: Create private clusters with authorized networks and no public endpoint.

detail: Network policy is not enabled on the cluster.
remediation: Enable NetworkPolicy enforcement on the cluster.

check_title: GKE uses legacy ABAC / no release channel
detail: Legacy ABAC authorization is enabled (cluster-wide permissions); cluster is not enrolled in a release channel (misses managed security upgrades).
remediation: Disable ABAC and enroll the cluster in a release channel.

detail: External identity user:vendor@partner.com holds roles/viewer; verify it is required and governed.
remediation: Remove external users or manage them through identity federation and access reviews.

check_title: Service account key older than 90 days
detail: Service account key is 210 days old (rotate within 90 days).
remediation: Rotate keys and move workloads to workload identity.

detail: Bucket has no retention policy; deleted objects cannot be recovered.
remediation: Configure retention policies on buckets holding regulated data.

detail: No lifecycle rules; stale or redundant objects accumulate cost and risk.
remediation: Define lifecycle rules to transition and delete stale objects.

detail: No lifecycle rules; stale or redundant objects accumulate cost and risk.
remediation: Define lifecycle rules to transition and delete stale objects.

detail: Instance has an external IP; prefer IAP or Cloud NAT for egress.
remediation: Remove external IPs and use IAP/Cloud NAT.

detail: Instance has an external IP; prefer IAP or Cloud NAT for egress.
remediation: Remove external IPs and use IAP/Cloud NAT.

detail: VPC flow logs are not enabled on this subnet.
remediation: Enable VPC flow logs on subnets (sampled 50%).

check_title: DNSSEC not enabled on all zones
detail: DNSSEC enabled on 1/3 managed zones.
remediation: Enable DNSSEC on production managed zones.

check_title: Cloud SQL not encrypted with CMEK
detail: Cloud SQL not encrypted with CMEK.
remediation: Encrypt instances with CMEK where required.

detail: Authorized networks include 0.0.0.0/0 (open to the internet).
remediation: Remove 0.0.0.0/0 and restrict to trusted CIDRs / private IP.

detail: Workload Identity is not enabled; pods must use long-lived keys or node IAM.
remediation: Enable Workload Identity on the cluster and namespaces.

detail: Shielded nodes are disabled; nodes lack secure boot and integrity monitoring.
remediation: Enable shielded nodes (secure boot + integrity monitoring).

detail: Cluster master endpoint is publicly accessible (private endpoint access disabled).
remediation: Enable private endpoint access and disable public access.

detail: All clusters send logs and metrics.
remediation: Enable Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring for the cluster.

detail: BigQuery dataset is publicly readable (allUsers binding).
remediation: Remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers bindings.

detail: Dataset uses Google-managed keys, not CMEK.
remediation: Set a default CMEK on datasets where required.

detail: Secret rotation policy is not configured.
remediation: Configure rotation periods on all secrets.

detail: The iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains constraint is not enforced; external principals can be added to IAM.
remediation: Enforce domain-restricted sharing at the organization.

check_title: VM external IP constraint not enforced
detail: VM external IP constraint - enforced.
remediation: Restrict compute.vmExternalIpAccess at the organization.

detail: Data access audit logging is not enabled (only admin activity is captured).
remediation: Enable DATA_READ/DATA_WRITE audit logs for sensitive services.

detail: Cloud Run service allows unauthenticated invocation (allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers).
remediation: Remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers from the service IAM policy; require authentication.

check_title: Cloud Run accepts all internet traffic
detail: Cloud Run service accepts traffic from the internet (ingress all).
remediation: Restrict ingress to internal/LB traffic.

detail: Memorystore transit encryption (TLS) is disabled.
remediation: Enable transit encryption (SERVER_AUTHENTICATION).

detail: Memorystore AUTH is disabled; anyone who can reach the instance can read/write data.
remediation: Enable AUTH with a strong password or IAM auth.

detail: Memorystore instance has a public IP; no private service connect.
remediation: Use Private Service Connect / VPC peering with private IPs.

detail: Serial port access is enabled; interactive console access bypasses SSH controls.
remediation: Disable serial-port-enable metadata on instances.

detail: Confidential computing is not enabled on the instance.
remediation: Enable confidential computing on sensitive workloads.

detail: Access logging is not enabled on the bucket.
remediation: Enable access logging to a dedicated log bucket.

check_title: Primitive role assigned to a service account
detail: No primitive roles on service accounts.
remediation: Replace primitive roles with least-privilege roles.

detail: CPU is always allocated (throttling disabled); billing and attack surface increase.
remediation: Re-enable CPU throttling for request-driven services.

detail: Maximum instances is unlimited; a traffic spike can scale without bound.
remediation: Set a maximum instance count per service.

detail: Artifact Registry repository is publicly readable.
remediation: Remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers from repository IAM.

detail: Repository is not encrypted with a customer-managed key.
remediation: Configure a customer-managed encryption key.

detail: Node auto-upgrade is disabled; node OS and kubelet fixes are applied late.
remediation: Enable node auto-upgrade on all node pools.

detail: Node auto-repair is disabled; unhealthy nodes are not replaced automatically.
remediation: Enable node auto-repair on all node pools.

detail: Instance deletion protection is disabled; an accidental delete destroys the VM.
remediation: Enable deletion protection on production instances.

detail: OS Login is not enforced; instances rely on SSH keys that are hard to revoke.
remediation: Enforce the compute.requireOsLogin organization constraint.

detail: Point-in-time recovery is disabled; data can only be restored to the last backup.
remediation: Enable point-in-time recovery in backup configuration.

detail: Persistence is disabled; cached data is lost on failover or maintenance.
remediation: Enable RDB/AOF persistence on production caches.

detail: Cloud Function is publicly invokable by any caller.
remediation: Require authentication on the function trigger.

detail: Cloud Function has no VPC connector; it cannot reach private resources securely.
remediation: Attach a VPC connector for private resource access.

detail: Tunnel uses IKEv1; the deprecated protocol is weaker and unsupported for new use.
remediation: Recreate tunnels with IKEv2.

detail: Workload identity pool has no OIDC/JWT provider; external federation cannot be trusted.
remediation: Add an OIDC/JWT provider to the pool or remove it.

detail: Firewall rule logging is disabled; denied/allowed traffic is not recorded.
remediation: Enable firewall rule logging for production rules.

detail: Binary Authorization is disabled; unsigned or malicious images can be deployed.
remediation: Enable Binary Authorization (GKE default deny) on clusters.

detail: Cloud Run service has no VPC connector; it cannot reach private resources securely.
remediation: Attach a VPC connector to the service.

check_title: Vertex AI notebook with public external IP
detail: Vertex AI notebook has a public external IP; Jupyter access and the instance are reachable from the internet.
remediation: Create notebooks in a VPC with no external IP; access via IAP or a bastion host.

detail: Vertex AI notebook disks are not encrypted with a customer-managed key (CMEK).
remediation: Attach a customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) when creating the notebook instance.

detail: Pub/Sub topic is not encrypted with a customer-managed key (CMEK); message data is protected only by Google-managed keys.
remediation: Enable customer-managed encryption (CMEK) on the topic at creation time.
